verdict.rationale: Pulley documents drafting SAFEs from standard YC templates and collecting board and investor signatures in-platform without a third-party e-signature tool. Its cap table has dedicated SAFE and Convertible Note tabs, and its fundraising modeling offers SAFE pro-formas. missing for 10: explicit evidence that executed SAFEs post automatically to the cap table, documentation of how conversion terms (cap, discount, MFN) are modeled, in-platform creation of convertible notes, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create, send, and e-sign SAFEs or convertible notes in-platform, and they land on the cap table with their conversion terms modeled

citations.quote: Create your agreements using standard Y-combinator SAFE templates instead of starting from scratch.
Collect both board member and investor signatures through Pulley, without needing a third-party e-signature tool.
Draft and execute rock-solid SAFEs in record time
Contract-specific tabs: Such as Shares, SAFEs, RSAs, RSUs, Convertible Notes, etc.
Get a pro-forma for your next priced round or SAFE.
